children: BJ's Wholesale Club promoted Bill Werner to Executive Vice President, Chief Development Officer and awarded Laura Felice a settlement payment in recognition of their roles in resolving interchange fee litigation.
Executive Vice President, Chief Development Officer (previously Executive Vice President, Strategy and Development)
Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
October 8, 2026 (promotion); RSU grant date Sept 30, 2026; RSU vesting on second anniversary of grant date
Expanded responsibilities managing B2B operations and growth strategies across real estate and fuel; recognition for contribution to settlement
Recognition for contribution to successful resolution of interchange fee litigation
Will assume additional responsibilities for managing B2B operations and lead growth strategies across real estate and fuel; employment agreement dated May 10, 2021 remains in effect
Annual base salary increased to $800,000; RSUs granted Sept 30, 2026 with $500,000 grant-date value (vests in full on second anniversary)
